stream_contract.stdout: Only stream call0001-stdout may be parsed as lscpu data
stream_contract.stderr: Original diagnostic artifact call0001-stderr is preserved and attributed, but not passed to lscpu semantic parser, and not counted as a parser failure
stream_contract.order: At most one stdout and one stderr, recorded in stdout then stderr order if both present; do not infer missing stdout from stderr text
stream_contract.command: Receipt invocation exactly lscpu for a captured attempt; source_paths must be empty. Recorded nonzero/timeout status remains independent of any parse outcome.

interpretation: Conservative bounded key: value lscpu output as one ordered ARRAY of {label:string,value:string} fields; no numeric or unit assertions and no requirement to use English/locale-specific labels. Original bytes retained losslessly, stderr remains diagnostic; other stdout formats fail attributed parsing rather than invent data.

cases.expected: valid lscpu Architecture and CPU(s) lines produce one typed ARRAY datum cpu.lscpu.rows from stdout only, plus original; SHA and same-run binding
stdout plus nonempty stderr preserves both originals but only stdout normalized; stderr does NOT produce PARSE_FAILED
unexpected localized labels accepted as opaque label string, never English CPU count claim
duplicated/reordered/forged call stream artifact names and cross-run evidence reject before manifest
unapproved command invocation, fake source_paths, call0002-stdout, wrong source receipt reject
stderr-only CAPTURED does not fabricate completed acquisition, invalid data fails closed
malformed no-colon stdout, invalid UTF-8, too many lines/overlong output yield actual parser error with sealed fallback
transport denied or tool missing yields zero parsed bytes and truthful unavailable status

review: Source-first interpretation of existing D1 artifact naming and status contracts; same AI agent as implementation, no independent human signoff.
risk: No change to G5-03 execution argv, privileges, evidence writer, approved sources or report publication. Does not claim complete numeric lscpu interpretation; deliberately preserves localized value strings.
